_comment: The hygiene ratchet (#781). Two TESTING.md conventions that lint cannot own — 'prefer specific matchers over toBeTruthy()' and 'assert outcomes, not mock calls' — measured as counts over **/*.test.{ts,tsx} by scripts/test-report/hygiene-ratchet.mjs and enforced DOWN-ONLY: a measured count above its budget is a hard failure (the convention cannot regress quietly), and a measured count BELOW its budget is also a failure, because the budget must always equal the measured count — improving the suite forces you to tighten the ceiling in the same change. `node scripts/test-report/hygiene-ratchet.mjs --write` does that reconciliation and can only ever LOWER a number; raising one is a deliberate, reviewed edit. Lint cannot enforce either rule: oxlint's prefer-to-be-truthy / prefer-to-be-falsy are off (#573) because their autofix runs the WRONG direction, rewriting the house-style toBe(true) into the strictly weaker toBeTruthy(); and prefer-called-with rewrites toHaveBeenCalled() into toHaveBeenCalledWith(), which asserts the mock was called with zero arguments. toBeTruthyFalsy counts .toBeTruthy( and .toBeFalsy(. toHaveBeenCalled counts the whole toHaveBeenCalled* family EXCEPT bare .not.toHaveBeenCalled(), which is exempt on purpose: there is no toHaveBeenCalledWith equivalent of 'never called', so naming arguments there would weaken the assertion rather than sharpen it (QUALITY.md #496: of 1,023 sites, all 186 bare ones were negated and zero positive bare calls remain). Seeded 2026-08-14 from the counts measured on that tree; the chip-away is #496's hygiene workstream, and every entry here is expected to fall. Raised 840->845 in the same #781 wave that seeded it: the Places mobile-seat tests (#781, places views) assert navigation through five toHaveBeenCalledOnce/toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith sites on the stubbed navigator, where the call with its exact route and params IS the observable outcome; a reviewed raise, not --write.
